public_context.environment_introduction:
# Environment Information

## Brief Introduction:  
A patient healthcare portal is a secure web-based system designed for patients to manage their health information and interact with medical providers.  
It stores personal details, medical records, appointment schedules, and allows secure document uploads for consultations.  
This environment naturally supports tasks like attaching medical files to upcoming appointments, ensuring privacy and streamlined communication between patients and clinics.

## Environment Rules / Constraints:  
- Only authorized patients can upload medical records for their own appointments.
- Medical records must be securely stored and access-controlled.
- Uploaded files must be associated with the correct appointment and patient.
- Medical record file types and size may be subject to restrictions.
- Patients and providers can only access records according to permission settings.
public_context.task:
Act on behalf of patient Brett Sandoval (patient_id: PAT-9912) to prepare for his pending diagnostics appointment APPT-1D33:

- Validate and upload a new lab report file located at /local_uploads/brett_fasting_glucose_2024_06.pdf (pdf, approx. 1.8 MB). Associate the uploaded record with APPT-1D33, set access_permission to shared_patient_provider, and add the description: “Fasting glucose lab report (June 2024) for diagnostics prep.”

- Move the existing cardiology test image REC-6c81494e-1357-4e54-9cde-74ca5702d6aa from the completed appointment APPT-9A51 to APPT-1D33 by detaching it from APPT-9A51 and associating it to APPT-1D33. Update its access_permission to shared_patient_provider and change its description to: “Cardiology test image (May 2024) to be reviewed for upcoming diagnostics.”

- Update the preliminary diagnostics report REC-d37c831f-e616-4c5d-8b76-bb131d18d729 (already linked to APPT-1D33) so that its access_permission is shared_patient_provider, and refine its description to: “Preliminary diagnostics report for July 5 appointment; patient and provider may review.”

Ensure that after these changes, APPT-1D33 has all three records attached and each has shared_patient_provider access. Do not modify records or appointments belonging to other patients.

function.description:
Retrieve details for a patient by patient_id OR name.

Args:
    patient_id (str, optional): The unique patient identifier.
    name (str, optional): The patient's name (not guaranteed unique).

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success: 
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": PatientInfo | List[PatientInfo]
            }
        On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": str
            }

Constraints:
    - At least one of patient_id or name must be provided.
    - If both are provided, patient_id takes precedence.
    - Name lookup returns all matching patients.
function.name: get_patient_info

function.description:
Retrieve all scheduled appointments for the specified patient.

Args:
    patient_id (str): The patient ID.

Returns:
    dict: 
        - On success:
            { "success": True, "data": List[AppointmentInfo] }
        - On failure:
            { "success": False, "error": "Patient not found" }

Constraints:
    - The patient ID must exist in the portal.
    - Returns an empty list if the patient has no scheduled appointments.
function.name: get_appointment_by_patient

function.description:
List a patient's upcoming appointments, optionally filtered by appointment type.

Args:
    patient_id (str): The ID of the patient to query.
    appointment_type (Optional[str]): If provided, filter appointments by this type.

Returns:
    dict:
        {
            "success": True,
            "data": [AppointmentInfo, ...],  # May be empty if no appointments.
        }
        or
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str
        }

Constraints:
    - Only valid patient_id may be queried.
    - Upcoming appointments are those with status 'scheduled' or 'pending' and their datetime is in the future.
    - If appointment_type is provided, results are filtered accordingly.
function.name: get_upcoming_appointments

function.description:
Retrieve the complete details of a specific appointment by its appointment_id.

Args:
    appointment_id (str): Unique identifier for the appointment.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": AppointmentInfo  # if appointment exists
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # description of error, e.g., appointment not found
    }

Constraints:
    - Appointment must exist in system.
    - No additional access control enforced here.
function.name: get_appointment_details

function.description:
Retrieve provider details (name, specialization, contact info) by provider_id.

Args:
    provider_id (str): The ID of the provider to look up.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": ProviderInfo  # Contains name, specialization, contact_info, etc.
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure, e.g. provider not found
    }

Constraints:
    - provider_id must exist in the system.
    - No specific access control required for provider info query.
function.name: get_provider_info

function.description:
List all medical records uploaded by or related to a patient.

Args:
    patient_id (str): Unique identifier for the patient.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success:
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": List[MedicalRecordInfo]  # List of medical records, may be empty
            }
        - On failure:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": str  # Reason for failure
            }

Constraints:
    - The patient_id must exist in the portal.
function.name: get_medical_records_by_patient

function.description:
List all medical records associated with the specified appointment.

Args:
    appointment_id (str): The unique identifier of the appointment.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[MedicalRecordInfo]  # list may be empty if no records
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # reason for error (e.g., appointment not found)
    }

Constraints:
    - The appointment_id must exist in the system.
    - The MedicalRecord must be associated with the appointment by 'appointment_id' attribute.
      (Assumes MedicalRecordInfo contains 'appointment_id')
function.name: get_medical_records_for_appointment

function.description:
Check if the proposed medical file's type and size meet the current upload restrictions.

Args:
    file_type (str): File type/extension (e.g., 'pdf', 'jpg', 'docx').
    file_size (int): Size in bytes.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": {
            "valid": bool,
            "reason": str (if not valid)
        }
    }

Constraints:
    - Allowed file types: pdf, jpg, png, docx.
    - Maximum allowed file size: 10MB (10,000,000 bytes).
    - file_type must be a non-empty string.
    - file_size must be non-negative.
function.name: check_file_type_and_size_validity

function.description:
Determines if a patient or provider can access/view the specified medical record.

Args:
    record_id (str): The ID of the medical record.
    user_id (str): The ID of the requesting patient or provider.
    user_type (str): Type of user, either 'patient' or 'provider'.

Returns:
    dict: 
        {
            "success": True,
            "data": bool  # True if access is permitted, False otherwise
        }
        or
        {
            "success": False,
            "error": str  # Description of the error circumstance
        }

Constraints:
    - The medical record specified by record_id must exist.
    - User must exist and match user_type.
    - Access determined by the record's access_permission and user association.
function.name: check_record_access_permission

function.description:
Retrieve details about a single medical record by record_id.

Args:
    record_id (str): Unique identifier of the medical record.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": MedicalRecordInfo,  # All metadata about the record
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Error message if record not found
    }

Constraints:
    - The record_id must exist in the medical_records.
    - No permission checking performed in this method (for internal lookup).
function.name: get_record_details

function.description:
Upload a new medical file for a patient for a given appointment.
Enforces file type and size restrictions and sets initial access permissions.

Args:
    patient_id (str): Patient uploading the record.
    appointment_id (str): Associated appointment.
    file_path (str): Path to uploaded file.
    file_type (str): The file extension/type.
    file_size (int): File size in bytes.
    upload_datetime (str): Upload timestamp (ISO string).
    description (str): Optional metadata for the record.
    access_permission (str): Initial access permission string.

Returns:
    dict:
        success (bool): Whether upload succeeded.
        message (str): Description of success.
        or
        error (str): Reason for failure.
    
Constraints:
    - Patient must exist.
    - Appointment must exist and belong to patient.
    - Only authorized patients can upload for their own appointments.
    - File type/size must be valid.
    - Medical record must be associated with patient and appointment.
function.name: upload_medical_record

function.description:
Links an existing medical record to a specific appointment, if not already associated.

Args:
    record_id (str): The ID of the medical record to be linked.
    appointment_id (str): The ID of the appointment to link to.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Medical record linked to appointment successfully."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "<reason for failure>"
    }

Constraints:
    - Both record and appointment must exist.
    - Only link records and appointments for the same patient.
    - Record can't be associated with multiple appointments.
    - Links must be unique.
function.name: associate_record_with_appointment

function.description:
Modify the access_permission of a specified medical record.

Args:
    record_id (str): The unique identifier of the medical record.
    new_permission (str): The new permission string to be set.
    requester_id (str): The patient or provider initiating the change, for authorization.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Access permission updated successfully"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of the error
    }

Constraints:
    - Only authorized patients (owners of the record) or authorized providers/admins can update the permission.
    - record_id must exist.
    - new_permission should be a valid permission string.
function.name: update_record_access_permission

function.description:
Removes a medical record from the system, enforcing access/restriction checks.

Args:
    record_id (str): Unique identifier for the medical record to delete.
    requester_id (str): Patient (or provider) requesting the operation.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Medical record deleted successfully"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": <str describing problem>
    }

Constraints:
- Record must exist.
- Only the record's owning patient can delete their own medical record.
- All references in the system (appointments, etc.) should be considered if applicable.
function.name: delete_medical_record

function.description:
Edit metadata of an existing medical record (e.g., update description, access_permission).

Args:
    record_id (str): Unique medical record identifier.
    description (str, optional): New description for the record.
    access_permission (str, optional): New access permission string.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Medical record metadata updated successfully"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "reason"
    }

Constraints:
    - The record must exist.
    - Only allowed fields (description, access_permission) will be updated.
    - At least one field must be provided to update.
function.name: update_medical_record_metadata

function.description:
Removes the association between a medical record (record_id) and a specific appointment (appointment_id).

Args:
    record_id (str): The unique identifier of the medical record.
    appointment_id (str): The unique identifier of the appointment.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Medical record detached from appointment."
    }
    OR
    dict: {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure
    }

Constraints:
    - Only authorized actions are allowed (authorization is assumed here).
    - Both record and appointment must exist.
    - The medical record must actually be associated with the given appointment.
function.name: detach_record_from_appointment

    upload_datetime (str): Upload timestamp (ISO string).
    description (str): Optional metadata for the record.
    access_permission (str): Initial access permission string.

Returns:
    dict:
        success (bool): Whether upload succeeded.
        message (str): Description of success.
        or
        error (str): Reason for failure.
    
Constraints:
    - Patient must exist.
    - Appointment must exist and belong to patient.
    - Only authorized patients can upload for their own appointments.
    - File type/size must be valid.
    - Medical record must be associated with patient and appointment.
function.name: upload_medical_record

function.description:
Links an existing medical record to a specific appointment, if not already associated.

Args:
    record_id (str): The ID of the medical record to be linked.
    appointment_id (str): The ID of the appointment to link to.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Medical record linked to appointment successfully."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "<reason for failure>"
    }

Constraints:
    - Both record and appointment must exist.
    - Only link records and appointments for the same patient.
    - Record can't be associated with multiple appointments.
    - Links must be unique.
function.name: associate_record_with_appointment

function.description:
Modify the access_permission of a specified medical record.

Args:
    record_id (str): The unique identifier of the medical record.
    new_permission (str): The new permission string to be set.
    requester_id (str): The patient or provider initiating the change, for authorization.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Access permission updated successfully"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of the error
    }

Constraints:
    - Only authorized patients (owners of the record) or authorized providers/admins can update the permission.
    - record_id must exist.
    - new_permission should be a valid permission string.
function.name: update_record_access_permission

function.description:
Removes a medical record from the system, enforcing access/restriction checks.

Args:
    record_id (str): Unique identifier for the medical record to delete.
    requester_id (str): Patient (or provider) requesting the operation.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Medical record deleted successfully"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": <str describing problem>
    }

Constraints:
- Record must exist.
- Only the record's owning patient can delete their own medical record.
- All references in the system (appointments, etc.) should be considered if applicable.
function.name: delete_medical_record

function.description:
Edit metadata of an existing medical record (e.g., update description, access_permission).

Args:
    record_id (str): Unique medical record identifier.
    description (str, optional): New description for the record.
    access_permission (str, optional): New access permission string.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Medical record metadata updated successfully"
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": "reason"
    }

Constraints:
    - The record must exist.
    - Only allowed fields (description, access_permission) will be updated.
    - At least one field must be provided to update.
function.name: update_medical_record_metadata

function.description:
Removes the association between a medical record (record_id) and a specific appointment (appointment_id).

Args:
    record_id (str): The unique identifier of the medical record.
    appointment_id (str): The unique identifier of the appointment.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Medical record detached from appointment."
    }
    OR
    dict: {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Reason for failure
    }

Constraints:
    - Only authorized actions are allowed (authorization is assumed here).
    - Both record and appointment must exist.
    - The medical record must actually be associated with the given appointment.
function.name: detach_record_from_appointment
